responsibility: Defines machine-description patterns for position-independent accesses to local symbols on RISC-V. It provides load and store forms for integer and floating-point objects addressed through absolute_symbolic_operand/PC-relative address macros, including hard-float and soft-float variants and the scratch-register conventions needed to materialize addresses, making it the backend’s focused RTL support for PIC data references rather than general address legality or call handling.
